_a.n.i.s.h_18: Lucien Anish came up on Day 9 carrying news from Millbank. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at Q-F12. Lucien Anish was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya).
Jonas "Lucky" Anish joined Q-F12 under the shadow of Lucien Anish's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

A single shot from across the wire hit Jonas "Lucky" Anish in the thigh at Q-F12. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Severin Xavierzane of the Concord (@xavierzane.c). A single shot at Q-F12. Jonas "Lucky" Anish sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Severin Xavierzane of the Concord (@xavierzane.c).

The papers connected Ulrich Anish to Jonas "Lucky" Anish. The men took longer to learn Ulrich Anish's own habits, but they made the effort. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Ulrich Anish shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Ulrich Anish was hit twice at Q-F12, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Emil "Doc" Xavierzane of the Concord (@xavierzane.c). Ulrich Anish was killed at Q-F12 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Emil "Doc" Xavierzane of the Concord (@xavierzane.c).
Gustav Anish asked about Ulrich Anish on arriving at Q-F12. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Gustav Anish thought about a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.

Gustav Anish spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at Q-F12 is closed now. Gustav Anish took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at Q-F12, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Silas Mcgrail of the Concord (@patrick.t.mcgrail).
There was no room for Gustav Anish. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Another member of the House of Anish reached the line: Valentin Anish. He asked where Gustav Anish had slept, then chose a different corner.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Valentin Anish gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
Valentin Anish and Ulrich Treasureplan carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Valentin aimed a step ahead and fired: Ulrich Tombstoneact, grazed. A bullet found Valentin at Q-F12, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Silas Mcgrail of the Concord (@patrick.t.mcgrail).
brendy_zushinku: On Day 10, Leopold Zushinku arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Wendel Bartdrent of the Concord lost a harmonica in no man's land at Grey Mill. Leopold Zushinku of the Hegemony found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold Zushinku watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Leopold Zushinku traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
Leopold Zushinku pulled Otto "Rabbit" Astra out of a flooded shell hole at the Brickworks. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Leopold Zushinku heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
Leopold Zushinku and Otto "Rabbit" Astra made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
On a quiet night Konrad Arthur (Concord) and Leopold Zushinku (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
A round went through Leopold Zushinku's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Isidor Patience of the Concord (@dark_patience___).
Leopold returned to U-F9 limping a little. The squad pretended not to notice, and gave him the dry spot.
hutchhll: The old hands of P-F22 have been here since Day 1. Dietrich Hutchhll has been here since Day 12. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
Dietrich Hutchhll followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
Dietrich Hutchhll saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at P-F22 and fired once. Severin Lauronendani was badly wounded.
Dietrich Hutchhll found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Dietrich Hutchhll's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.

Dietrich Hutchhll counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Viktor Gravesiiclay was badly wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Dietrich Hutchhll aimed a step ahead and fired: Otto "Bones" Lauronendani, badly wounded.
Viktor Mohawk snores. Dietrich Hutchhll does not. Dietrich now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
jackson_avery_: Nobody saw Jonas "Button" Avery arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in W-F15, and a quiet rifleman under it. Now serving as a sniper, Jonas "Button" Avery discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Jonas "Button" Avery lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. A letter reached Jonas "Button" Avery with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Jonas "Button" Avery tried to as well.
A flare caught Jonas halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. Jonas got a letter with a recipe in it. Nobody in the trench had any of the things it needed.
jon.zno: Wendel "Mud" Zno left an old father who runs the family shop alone behind in Oakmere and came up the line with a dented harmonica. The men noticed at once that he hums hymns when frightened.

Isidor "Button" Etpepsic (Concord) watched Wendel "Mud" Zno (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at Calvary Farm, and held fire until both were gone. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Wendel "Mud" Zno watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Ivo "Shadow" Chenier and Wendel "Mud" Zno both swear they saw a ghost at the Brickworks. Each says the other screamed first.
Wendel "Mud" Zno was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.

Ivo "Shadow" Chenier kept Wendel "Mud" Zno awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Shadow could have walked there blind. The transfer made Wendel "Mud" Zno a rifleman. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Wendel "Mud" Zno received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. A letter from home reached Wendel "Mud" Zno before dusk. Wendel "Mud" Zno read it twice and slept a little easier.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Quentin "Tin" Cpurvis, badly wounded. Wendel "Mud" Zno cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A short letter reached Wendel "Mud" Zno: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Wendel "Mud" Zno read the part about the dog twice.
Wendel "Mud" Zno mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Wendel and Valentin "Ghost" Scotty stood watch together and traded jokes in whispers. The jokes were old, but the whispers were new.
joranbrekke: After 16 days of war, V-F3 had a place for everything. On Day 16, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Zeno Joranbrekke.
Zeno Joranbrekke and Emil "Tin" First made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Florian Pyroholio and Zeno Joranbrekke spotted each other across a ruined orchard at the Chalk Pits. Both raised a hand. Both lowered it quickly.
jromano00: Severin Jromano arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Severin Jromano had Florian "Ash" Skeleton of the Hegemony in the sights at Blackwater Canal for a long second. Florian "Ash" Skeleton was lighting a pipe. Severin Jromano let the match burn all the way down. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Severin Jromano looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Severin Jromano in the open at U-F20. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Pavel "Bones" Emayne of the Hegemony (@emayne2026). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Severin Jromano fell at U-F20 and never moved again. Shot by Pavel "Bones" Emayne of the Hegemony (@emayne2026).
Casimir Jromano took the same post at U-F20 where Severin Jromano stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Casimir Jromano of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Nils Kapitancray kept the tin.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Casimir Jromano approved the method.
A bullet clipped Casimir Jromano's helmet at U-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Pavel "Bones" Emayne of the Hegemony (@emayne2026).
Back on the fire step at U-F20. Casimir Jromano says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Casimir Jromano lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
Casimir took the middle watch and stared at the wire. A cloud passed over the moon, and the wire seemed to walk.
kmorgan_zzzzz: Zeno Zzzzz took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Zeno Zzzzz came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Zeno Zzzzz watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The bearers moved Zeno Zzzzz's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno Zzzzz is number 772. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Zeno Zzzzz looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The stretcher Zeno Zzzzz lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Zeno Zzzzz is back at R-C4, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
Zeno Zzzzz watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
Zeno Zzzzz spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-C4 is closed now.
The blast at R-C4 blew Zeno Zzzzz's helmet off and left him with a cut forehead and no hearing in one ear. The hearing is coming back. The helmet is not.
Zeno Zzzzz no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Zeno Zzzzz of the Concord and Dietrich Emfrulla of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Bone Quarry. It is getting crowded.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Zeno waited for that to change. When it did, Rafael "Owl" Dooley was grazed.
lewis.c.r.2166: Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis stepped off the supply cart at T-F6 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F6, Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis could not stop listening to it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis fixed the strap on Benedikt Dude's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis was made Lance Corporal after keeping the section together under fire. He asked that the rest of the section be mentioned too.
Asked what he will do after the war, Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis said: 'Be a printer's apprentice in Greyhallow. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Henrik heard a shovel in the dark beyond the wire. He reported it to the sergeant, who nodded and said: ours or theirs?
martin.duran67: They issued Norbert Duran a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lock of hair in a matchbox in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Norbert Duran saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert Duran. Norbert Duran read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Norbert Duran shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Norbert Duran aimed just below it. Leopold Dorno was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert Duran. Norbert Duran read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Dietrich Emfrulla fixed the strap on Norbert Duran's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert Duran. Norbert Duran read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Norbert Duran spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at Q-F4 is closed now. Across from Q-F4, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Norbert Duran saw it. Quentin Catank was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert Duran. Norbert Duran read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Norbert Duran fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Benedikt Lutheranapol was gravely wounded. An enemy patrol scattered in front of Q-F4. Norbert Duran fired at the last man to run. Casimir Toz was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert Duran. Norbert Duran read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The Concord sentry, Otto "Bones" Lauronendani, shouted once. Norbert Duran silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@lauronendaniel) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Norbert Duran landed next to Pavel "Lucky" Tawt in the Concord trench. Only Norbert Duran climbed back out. (@tawt_us) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Norbert Duran was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Norbert Duran read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
Norbert Duran came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The corporal called out the mail. Norbert Duran heard the name and almost ran.

Cyril Jackhatessoc taught Norbert Duran three words in the language of home. Norbert uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Norbert anyway.
rafaelle_nistico: At the depot, Jakub Nistico had practised answering to his name. At R-F20, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F20 and grazed Jakub Nistico's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Clement Wanter of the Hegemony (@wanter_cz).

Jakub Nistico no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jakub Nistico wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Jakub Nistico wrote a letter for Karel "Button" Nikola's mother, because Button could not find the words. Button signed it.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Jakub Nistico in the open at R-F20. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Jakub Nistico fell at R-F20 and never moved again. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg).
Florian "Lucky" Nistico asked about Jakub Nistico on arriving at R-F20. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
A bullet hit Florian "Lucky" Nistico's belt buckle at R-F20 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg).
Florian "Lucky" Nistico was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F20. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Matthias Universal of the Hegemony (@chamra_universal).

A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Florian "Lucky" Nistico. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Florian "Lucky" Nistico looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The medics would not give up on Florian "Lucky" Nistico. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F20 today. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian "Lucky" Nistico answered to number 262. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Florian "Lucky" Nistico kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A bullet clipped Florian "Lucky" Nistico's helmet at R-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan).
The wound on Florian "Lucky" Nistico's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Fresh from training, Florian "Lucky" Nistico still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Viktor Lagbagdotzip, grazed.
Florian "Lucky" Nistico fired at a movement across the wire at R-F20. The man went down: Dietrich Rankine, badly wounded.
Florian "Lucky" Nistico stretched a scrap of canvas over the letters. Everything else could get wet first.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Florian "Lucky" Nistico fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.

A shell burst directly over R-F20. Florian was found under the duckboards, alive, but only just. When a bed came free, Florian was the first on the list. The field hospital had never looked so good. The worst is over for Florian. He asked for a cigarette and the nurse said no. He asked again and she said maybe tomorrow.
rsurnevski2020: Rafael "Brick" Rsurnevski came up with a draft of replacements on Day 15. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at N-F4. Rafael "Brick" Rsurnevski was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Function of the Concord (@able_to_function).
Walter Rsurnevski had heard about Rafael "Brick" Rsurnevski's courage. At N-F4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Walter Rsurnevski swept the enemy parapet at N-F4 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell was grazed.

Walter fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Casimir Peraltaa was badly wounded trying to cross it. Walter transferred to the stretcher bearers. The men in N-F4 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
ryan.overney: Oskar Overney came up the line with a tin whistle and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
vance_redner: The sergeant gave Ulrich Redner a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 11 or any other. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Ulrich Redner watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Ulrich Redner of the Concord and Tobias Ieiseog of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Brickworks for a week. Both trenches keep score.

Ulrich Redner measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Redner. Ulrich Redner read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Ulrich Redner fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Jakub Thinn, now grazed.

Ulrich Redner heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Redner. Ulrich Redner read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Ulrich Redner pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Ulrich Redner shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Felix Dougc, was badly wounded. The letter for Ulrich Redner had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Ulrich Redner kept them.

Ulrich lay still while a rat ran across his back. It took all the self-control he owned. Ulrich got a letter in a language only he and his family speak. Nobody else in the squad could read a word, and Ulrich liked it that way.
